name: actuating union change
from: A work-lot plan sitting inert, and no Leader-issued authority yet consumed to make any of it a real filesystem mutation.
to: An ActuationPlanK integrated against the requirement, architecture, high-level design, low-level design, and work lots, and -- only once LeaderAuthorityK is consumed -- a CandidatePatchK: an actual Codex-authored mutation on disk.
cost: The offices own direct-incubation attention integrating five upstream knowledge classes into one plan, and then spending its one authority-bounded mutation privilege to execute it.
otherwise: A plan is designed and decomposed and never actually reaches the filesystem, or the opposite failure -- a mutation reaches the filesystem without ever having consumed a Leader authority receipt.
